evidence.title: Etobicoke Construction Update
evidence.excerpt: Microsoft's August 5 update describes its first Etobicoke datacentre as an unfinished construction project, with building completion forecast for fall 2026 and installation and preparation continuing thereafter. The facility is explicitly not operational.

metadata.observation_date_basis: August 5 is the dated current construction update, not construction onset. Its timeline describes continuing building/installation work and explicitly excludes operation. Generic under_construction only; no shell, foundations, MEP or commissioning substage selected.

literal_pointer.scope: Complete construction-timeline paragraph excluding surrounding HTML.

metadata.onset_conflict: The introduction says first-phase development construction began in May 2024; the timeline gives November 21, 2024. No onset date is normalized and no distinction between those dates is invented.
metadata.successor_guardrail: July22 municipal motion says the applicant is pursuing conditional occupancy, not that occupancy was issued or the datacentre was operating. August5 operator expressly says not operational. Bounded authoritative completion/cancellation checks found no decisive successor through August20; YTO40 statutory-certificate index returned zero results. Absence is not proof of no later event.
metadata.phase_scope: First building/current initial construction only. Forecast completion/installation dates are not actual delivery or operating dates. No future campus phase, tenant, capacity, workload or operating model is selected.
